subject: Evaluation handoff: credentials, testcases, and restricted-use timeline
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@quantex.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation handoff: credentials, testcases, and restricted-use timeline

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our discussion, we put together an initial mutual action plan (MAP) and an access plan so Quantex can run the evaluation suite against Redwood's hosted model variants. The goal is to get a 2–3 week controlled evaluation while protecting Quantex IP and our shared testcases.

High-level proposal:
- Week 0 (this week): sign MAP and data handling addendum.
- Week 1: Quantex ingests the promptpack and probe testcases into your secure sandbox.
- Weeks 2–3: run evaluation, share sample output for quality checks.
- Week 4: close and destroy ephemeral test data per the retention schedule.

Key constraints we need Quantex to confirm:
- Assets are for evaluation only; no training of models or redistribution.
- Ephemeral access tokens will expire after 72 hours; long-term transfer requires an approved business purpose and redline.
- Results that contain Quantex PII must be deleted and reported to your security contact (see MAP sec section).

Attached: QX-MAP-v1.pdf (MAP draft), a stub referencing the testcases bundle and prompt pack. We can provide the actual artifact delivery via a pre-signed S3 link (short-lived) or an SFTP account scoped to the evaluation IPs you provide.

Next steps I propose:
1) Sign the MAP (DocuSign link included in the attached PDF) or send redlines by EOD Mon, Jan 12.
2) Confirm preferred delivery mechanism (S3 presigned / SFTP) and retention window.
3) Provide names/emails for the two engineers who will receive dataset access.

If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute handoff to walk through the bundle contents and the usage checks.

—
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment stubs: QX-MAP-v1.pdf; testcase and promptpack bundles will be delivered after MAP signature.

From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@quantex.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Bishop <tom.bishop@quantex.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation handoff: credentials, testcases, and restricted-use timeline

Olga —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few points from our side:
- We can agree to an evaluation-only restriction, but our legal team will insist on a 30-day maximum retention after the final close (rather than your default 14); can you confirm that is acceptable?
- For the delivery mechanism, S3 pre-signed links are easiest for our infra team. We will need the link to be pinned to our IP allowlist.
- Please remove any production PII from the sample testcases before transfer; if that's not possible, we'll need a redaction checklist.

I'll pull in Legal if we have to redline the MAP; otherwise we can return an executed DocuSign by Jan 14.

Also, can you include a one-page checklist for what your team expects back after the evaluation (aggregated metrics + a single representative transcript per failing testcase)? That speeds up our acceptance process.

Thanks,
Sophie Lane
Head of ML Ops
Quantex Labs
sophie.lane@quantex.com

Subject: Re: Evaluation handoff: credentials, testcases, and restricted-use timeline

Sophie —

Thanks — we can accommodate the 30-day post-close retention window, provided Quantex accepts the additional data handling checklist and periodic audit access outlined in the MAP sec addendum (attached).

Delivery approach and access:
- We prepared a secure artifact bundle and placed it in a pre-signed S3 location. The URL is emitted only after we receive the executed MAP via DocuSign. The presigned link will be valid for 72 hours and constrained to the IPs you provide.
- For longer access we can create an SFTP account scoped to the evaluation subnet, but that requires an additional access request form (attached as part of the MAP package).

Usage constraints (please confirm acceptance):
1) Evaluation-only: no model training, no redistribution, no derivative dataset publication without explicit written consent.
2) Attribution: Quantex may refer to Redwood as the inference provider but must not publish model internals or token-level logs.
3) Reporting: share aggregated metrics and up to 5 representative transcripts for problematic cases; redact PII.
4) Destruction: confirm deletion of ephemeral snapshots within 30 days of close; provide a deletion certificate or authenticated log excerpt.

Attached items (stubs):
- QX-MAP-v1.pdf (MAP + security addendum)
- testcase_quantex_v1.zip (contains probe suite; redaction recommended)
- promptpack_quantex_v1.tar.gz

DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/sign/QX-MAP-v1
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.example/contacts/12345

If this looks good, sign via DocuSign and reply with the two engineer contacts and the IP allowlist — we will emit the presigned link within 4 business hours of receiving the executed MAP.

I'll loop Legal if we see redlines. Marcus will coordinate the actual artifact delivery and Neha will handle security questions.

—
Olga
